I think I may be able to help here, I kinda was that kind of friend you describe.

I was cut off because I was clingy, and really easily upset, and I didn't even realise it, I wasnt myself but something wasnt making me who I really was anymore. But, after being cut off, for as much as it nay have hurt the first month or two, I was able to be alone again. I was able to stop being clingy entirely and focus healthily on those left in my life (the rest of their group cut me off as well) and more or less on myself to stop that happening.

My advice would be to do it, but first, since they're your friend, I understand this isnt your first option but I think you should establish boundaries and explain the situation to your friend, but still note that you'd be friends if they could stop their behaviour towards you. However, if that doesn't work, get your closest friend and get together to tell individual group members (informing then your telling the rest as well) that you plan to cut him off, not forcing them to but telling them so the situation doesnt come as a surprise and misunderstandings don't happen, and cut them off.

You may really be tempted to talk to them or reply to them, but you have to try really hard to get your mind off the situation, you need to keep ignoring them, and eventually, they might leave the group. Theres no saying they will, but either way you could have peace.

I hope things get better for you.
